changelog:
v3.8.0 — Home Refresh + Live TV Overhaul

HOME
• Quick Tune row removed for a cleaner layout.
• Hero 'Resume' — the main button now jumps straight back into whatever you were last watching.
• New 'Pick Up & New' rail merges new episodes and watch-it-again into one row.
• Rows fade in as they load; below-the-fold rows load on scroll for a faster start.

LIVE TV
• Channels now auto-preview as you browse (muted) — no more empty preview panel.
• Every channel shows what's on now; the focused channel shows a bigger preview with a live progress bar.
• One press to watch fullscreen.
• Cleaner, larger preview and channel text; smoother focus and crash hardening on big channel lists.
